name: Garmin Run Singapore 2026
short_description: Garmin Run Singapore 2026 is a half-marathon and 10km race held at Marina Barrage, Singapore on October 25, 2026.
ai_summary: Garmin Run Singapore 2026 is a half-marathon event organized by Garmin, scheduled for October 25, 2026, at Marina Barrage in Singapore. Participants can choose between a 21.1km half-marathon or a 10km race, with the half-marathon serving as the primary distance. Pricing is set at SGD 125 for the 21K and SGD 105 for the 10K. Registration has not yet been announced.
